The intended-product columns and the observed-redirect columns are separate fields and are never merged: an intended ASIN is a claim by the owner about what they meant to submit, while an observed destination is what a live link served on a given date. Only the owner can fill the intended columns; this session leaves them blank and flagged rather than copying the observed value into them.
field_rule: intended_* = owner-supplied, requires a confirmation date and a source. observed_* = what the link served when fetched, with the fetch date. A row is only complete when both sides exist and are recorded separately.
